figurative_meaning_en: Innocent, simple and straightforward; of ordinary type
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি একজন সাদাসিধা মানুষ, কোনো ছলাকলা নেই তার মধ্যে।
গ্রামের সাদাসিধা জীবন আমাদের শান্তি দেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a simple and straightforward person, without any deceit.
The plain and simple life in the village gives us peace.
history: Originated in Bengali folk traditions, as seen in songs by artists like Gupi Gayen Bagha Bayen, reflecting the humble rural ethos.
note: The idiom evokes the unpretentious nature of common folk in Bengali culture.
